name: table
label: Email Table
description: Table for the email record sys_email_draft or sys_email

name: sysId
label: Email Sys ID
description: Value of Sys ID, -1 for new email record

name: targetTable
label: Target table
description: Table for the record the email relates to

name: targetRecord
label: Target record Sys ID
description: Sys ID for the record the email relates to

name: replyId
label: Reply ID
description: If is a reply action this contains the original email Sys ID

name: replyType
label: Reply Type
description: One of replyAll, reply or forward

name: shouldFocus
label: Should focus email tab
description: Should transfer focus to the email tab upon updating the mini email composer payload

name: timestamp
label: Timestamp
description: Timestamp in milliseconds at the moment the action was requested
